product_overview.tagline: Transform boring barcodes into artistic SVG designs.
product_overview.target_user: Graphic designers, marketers, and small business owners looking to enhance their branding with unique barcodes.
product_overview.core_problem: Traditional barcodes are visually unappealing and can detract from overall design aesthetics.
product_overview.success_metric: Achieve 1000 unique barcode downloads within the first month of launch.

user_stories.story: As a graphic designer, I want to generate a barcode with my brand colors so that it matches my design aesthetic.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can select colors for the barcode; the generated barcode reflects the selected colors.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to preview my barcode in real-time so that I can see changes immediately.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User sees an updated preview of the barcode as they make changes to styles and colors.

user_stories.story: As a marketer, I want to download the barcode in multiple formats so that I can use it in different applications.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can download the barcode in SVG and PNG formats without errors.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to save my favorite barcode styles so that I can easily access them later.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can save and retrieve favorite styles from a user account.

user_stories.story: As a user, I want to share my barcode designs on social media so that I can showcase my work.
user_stories.acceptance_criteria: User can share the barcode design directly to social media platforms.

feature_spec.feature: SVG barcode generation with customizable colors and patterns
feature_spec.user_flow: User selects barcode type -> User customizes colors/patterns -> User clicks 'Generate' -> Barcode is displayed.
feature_spec.input: User-selected colors, patterns, and barcode type.

feature_spec.feature: Preview feature to see the barcode in real-time
feature_spec.user_flow: User selects customization options -> Barcode updates in real-time on preview area.

feature_spec.feature: Download options in multiple formats (SVG, PNG)
feature_spec.user_flow: User clicks 'Download' -> User selects format (SVG/PNG) -> File is downloaded.

data_collection_plan.privacy_notes: User data will be anonymized and used only for improving product features. No personal data will be collected without explicit consent.
